lines.x: Shares of zinc miners Nexa Resources and Buenaventura rose 4.11% and 7.62% respectively on November 4, supported by a weakening dollar and lower bond yields.
The US dollar opened at 3.46 Peruvian soles on Monday, down from 3.47 soles at the previous close, while inflation in Peru reached 5.25%.
Copper prices fell to a four-month low as market euphoria following the Democratic midterm election victory in the US gave way to investor nervousness and risk aversion.
Wholesale prices for corn have risen over 100% since January due to the El Niño phenomenon.
